purpose: Static evidence for the two unreachable cbaron:L5CA5 CMP #$00 / BCC branches before a full loader watch is available.
limitations: This is a static direct-address scan, not a full live loader watch.
It does not rule out an indirect write through a runtime pointer.
The raw-module VICE watch already rules out self-patching during isolated cbaron:$5806 execution.
The prepared full-disk watch still needs a working automated KERNAL LOAD path before it can prove loader-time behavior.
conclusion: No extracted ERBENT1A module contains a direct absolute store or absolute read-modify-write instruction targeting $5CC0-$5CDF. The disk cbaron bytes at $5CCC and $5CD6 are the unreachable CMP #$00 / BCC form.
